WITH systems_matching_name AS (
SELECT
  p."sitekey" AS system_id,
  p."sitelabel" AS system_name_raw,
  o."mttrh" AS mttr_raw,
  o."mtbfh" AS mtbf_raw
FROM "plants" p
JOIN "plant_record" r ON r."sitetie" = p."sitekey"
JOIN "operational_metrics" o ON o."snapops" = r."snapkey"
WHERE p."sitelabel" ILIKE /* target system name pattern, lift out */ '%' || /*TARGET_NAME*/ '' || '%'
),
normalize_metrics AS (
SELECT
  pr."snapkey" AS "system_id",
  -- canonicalize system name: trim, collapse internal spaces, lower-case
  regexp_replace(trim(coalesce(pr."sitetie", '')), '\s+', ' ', 'g')::text AS "system_name_norm",
  -- clean and cast MTTR: accept numeric-ish strings in operational_metrics.replcost? use mttrh field from operational_metrics
  -- If mttrh is NULL or not finite, set NULL. mttr in hours as numeric.
  CASE
    WHEN om."mttrh" IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE NULLIF( (om."mttrh")::text, '' )::double precision
  END AS "mttr",
  -- clean and cast MTBF: similar treatment for mtbfh
  CASE
    WHEN om."mtbfh" IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE NULLIF( (om."mtbfh")::text, '' )::double precision
  END AS "mtbf"
FROM "plant_record" pr
LEFT JOIN "operational_metrics" om
  ON om."snapops" = pr."snapkey"
),
compute_unavailability_per_system AS (
SELECT
  "systems_matching_name"."system_id" AS "system_id",
  CASE
    WHEN ("systems_matching_name"."mtbf_raw" IS NULL AND "systems_matching_name"."mttr_raw" IS NULL) THEN NULL
    WHEN (COALESCE("systems_matching_name"."mtbf_raw", 0::double precision) + COALESCE("systems_matching_name"."mttr_raw", 0::double precision)) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ("systems_matching_name"."mttr_raw"::numeric) / ( ("systems_matching_name"."mtbf_raw"::numeric) + ("systems_matching_name"."mttr_raw"::numeric) )
  END AS "unavailability_raw"
FROM "systems_matching_name"
)
SELECT to_char(ROUND(c.unavailability_raw::numeric, 4), 'FM999990.0000')::text
FROM compute_unavailability_per_system c
JOIN normalize_metrics n ON n.system_id = c.system_id
WHERE lower(n.system_name_norm) = 'solar plant west davidport'
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(COALESCE(adr,0.0) * 500000.0 * 0.12 * 15.0) AS grand_total_loss
FROM (
  SELECT p.sitekey,
         -- compute age in years, require goliveon not null
         EXTRACT(epoch FROM (current_date - p.goliveon)) / (365.25*24*3600) AS age_years,
         -- get cumulative degradation pct from panel_models.degyrrate (assumed percent value, convert to fraction)
         pm.degyrrate AS cumulative_degradation_pct,
         -- ADR = cumulative degradation pct / age in years (guard against zero/NULL)
         CASE
           WHEN p.goliveon IS NOT NULL AND pm.degyrrate IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(epoch FROM (current_date - p.goliveon)) > 0
           THEN (pm.degyrrate / 100.0) / (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (current_date - p.goliveon)) / (365.25*24*3600))
           ELSE NULL
         END AS adr
  FROM plants p
  JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.sitetie = p.sitekey
  LEFT JOIN plant_panel_model ppm ON ppm.sitelink = p.sitekey
  LEFT JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = ppm.modlink
  -- warranty claimed
  WHERE LOWER(p.warrstate) = 'claimed'
    -- have goliveon known
    AND p.goliveon IS NOT NULL
    -- ensure degradation known
    AND pm.degyrrate IS NOT NULL
    -- count claims >= 3: warrclaims column holds number of claims
    AND COALESCE(p.warrclaims,0) >= 3
) t
WHERE adr IS NOT NULL
